# duploai_admin_workspace (Resource)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk workspace — the top-level container that groups personas, scopes, a quota, and configuration for a team or tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Minimal workspace — only the required name.
resource "duploai_admin_workspace" "basic" {
  name = "support-team"
}

# Full workspace — labels, a system prompt, a quota, and persona/scope links.
resource "duploai_admin_workspace" "full" {
  name        = "platform-support"
  short_name  = "PLAT"
  description = "Platform support workspace"
  email       = "platform-support@example.com"
  role        = "support"
  team        = "platform"
  prompt_md   = "You are a DevOps assistant for the platform team. Help users manage infrastructure safely."

  quota_id = "6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e"

  persona_ids = [
    "69f1bc7e527b7c8f48e321a9",
  ]
  scope_ids = [
    "6a25105705686d697e0da225",
  ]

  meta_data = {
    tier   = "gold"
    region = "us-east-1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the workspace. The server stores the name in lowercase, so supply a lowercase value to avoid configuration drift. Changing the name forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `analytics_id` (String) ID of an analytics record associated with this workspace.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the workspace.
- `email` (String) Contact email address for the workspace. Must be a valid email address when set.
- `meta_data` (Map of String) Free-form key/value metadata associated with the workspace.
- `persona_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the personas available in this workspace. Provide the complete set; on update the full list replaces the previous one.
- `prompt_md` (String) Markdown system prompt applied to interactions within this workspace.
- `quota_id` (String) ID of the quota definition that limits this workspace's usage.
- `role` (String) Role label associated with the workspace.
- `scope_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the scopes you manage on this workspace. Scopes the backend attaches automatically (for example a Kubernetes scope created with a cluster) are not included here — they appear in system_scope_ids and are preserved across updates.
- `short_name` (String) Short identifier used as a prefix for tickets. Up to 10 characters, must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores. Must be unique across workspaces; when omitted, one is derived from the name.
- `team` (String) Team label associated with the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the workspace was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Composite resource identifier (workspace_id/id).
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the workspace is active.
- `system_scope_ids` (Set of String) IDs of scopes attached to this workspace by the backend (not managed in Terraform configuration), e.g. a Kubernetes scope created when a cluster is provisioned.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the workspace was last updated (RFC 3339).
- `version` (Number) Version counter, incremented on each update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing workspace.
#  - WORKSPACE_ID is the unique identifier of the workspace (e.g. 6a25105705686d697e0da225)
terraform import duploai_admin_workspace.myworkspace WORKSPACE_ID
# Example:
# terraform import duploai_admin_workspace.myworkspace 6a25105705686d697e0da225
```
